## HBVx Study — Serology Time Course Analysis

```{r}
# Sections:
#   0. Setup & Data Loading
#   1. Data Preparation & Derived Variables
#   2. Final Timepoint Titer Summary Plot (by Study Arm + CNBx)
#   3. HBVnaive-Alum: Kinetics & Age Effects
#   4. HBVimmune-Alum: Booster Response Kinetics
#   5. HBVnaive-CpG: Kinetics
#   6. Age-Titer Correlations (All Arms)
#   7. Laterality Analysis (HBVnaive-Alum)
#   8. Response Rate Barplot (HBVnaive-Alum)

```

## 0. Setup & Data Loading

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(reshape2)     # data reshaping
library(ggplot2)      # Plotting
library(dplyr)        # Data manipulation
library(readr)        # Reading CSV files
library(readxl)       # Reading Excel files
library(ggpubr)       # Publication-ready plots
library(gridExtra)    # Arranging grid layouts
library(cowplot)      # Arranging plots
library(rstatix)      # Statistical tests
library(tidyr)        # Tidy data principles
# library(GGally)       # Advanced plots
library(ggbeeswarm)   # Beeswarm plots
library(plotly)       # Interactive plots
library(patchwork)    # Combining ggplot plots
# library(extrafont)    # Using custom fonts
library(writexl)      # Writing to Excel files
# library(lubridate)    # Date-time manipulation
# library(ggnewscale)   # Multiple color scales in ggplot
library(ggrepel)      # Repel overlapping text labels
library(data.table)
library(emmeans)      # Estimated marginal means
library(lme4)         # Linear mixed-effects models
library(lmerTest)     # Tests for lme4 models
library(viridis)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggsci)


elisa_mergeMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta_with_offsetVisitDates.rds")

# Remove optional visits and one known duplicate
elisa_sub <- elisa_mergeMeta[!make.unique %like% "optional"]
elisa_sub  <- elisa_sub[!make.unique == "hbvx-0019_v2w4"]

tc <- function() {
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )}

```

## 1. Data Preparation & Derived Variables

```{r}
# --- Approximate time variables ---
# HBVnaive-Alum / HBVnaive-CpG: months post first vaccination
elisa_sub[, approxMonths := fcase(
  Visit == "v1w0", 0,
  Visit == "v1w1", 0.25,
  Visit == "v1w4", 1.00,
  Visit == "v2w0", 1.00,
  Visit == "v2w1", 1.25,
  Visit == "v2w4", 2,
  Visit == "v3w0", 6,
  Visit == "v3w1", 6.25,
  Visit == "v3w4", 7,
  default = NA_real_
)]

# HBVimmune-Alum: weeks post booster
elisa_sub[, approxWeeks := fcase(
  Visit == "v1w0", 0,
  Visit == "v1w1", 1,
  Visit == "v1w4", 4,
  Visit == "v2w0", 4,
  Visit == "v2w1", 5,
  Visit == "v2w4", 8,
  Visit == "v3w0", 24,
  Visit == "v3w1", 25,
  Visit == "v3w4", 28,
  default = NA_real_
)]

elisa_sub[, approxWeeks_fromDAYS := DaysFromFirstVisit / 7]


# --- Final-timepoint titer (study-arm-specific visit) ---
elisa_sub[, final.timepoint.hbsab := fcase(
  Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG"   & Visit == "v2w4", elisa.HBsAb,
  Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum"  & Visit == "v3w4", elisa.HBsAb,
  Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum" & Visit == "v1w4", elisa.HBsAb,
  default = NA_real_
)]

# hbvx-0069 missing v2w1 final visit — patch with v2w1 titer
missing_ln <- elisa_sub[Participant == "hbvx-0069" & Visit == "v2w1"]
missing_ln[, final.timepoint.hbsab := elisa.HBsAb]

final_timepoint_elisa <- rbind(
  elisa_sub[!is.na(final.timepoint.hbsab)],
  missing_ln
)

# --- Arm-specific subsets ---
elisa_naivealum  <- elisa_sub[Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum"]
elisa_immunealum <- elisa_sub[Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum"]
elisa_naivecpg   <- elisa_sub[Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG"]

# --- Flag participants with v1w0 HBsAb > 100 (pre-existing immunity screen) ---
pre_immune_ids <- elisa_sub[
  Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum" & Visit == "v1w0" & elisa.HBsAb > 100,
  Participant
]

elisa_sub[, v1w0_greater_100 := Participant %in% pre_immune_ids]

# --- Responder classification by final timepoint titer ---
# HBVnaive-Alum: classified at v3w4
elisa_naivealum[
  elisa_naivealum[Visit == "v3w4"],
  on = .(Participant),
  final_tmp_titer := fcase(
    i.elisa.HBsAb >  100, "Over100",
    i.elisa.HBsAb <= 100, "Under100",
    default = NA_character_
  )
]

# HBVimmune-Alum: classified at v1w4
elisa_immunealum[
  elisa_immunealum[Visit == "v1w4"],
  on = .(Participant),
  final_tmp_titer := fcase(
    i.elisa.HBsAb >  100, "Over100",
    i.elisa.HBsAb <= 100, "Under100",
    default = NA_character_
  )
]

# --- Ipsi/contra laterality (even/odd participant number) ---
elisa_naivealum[,
  Laterality := ifelse(
    as.numeric(sub(".*(\\d)$", "\\1", Participant)) %% 2 == 0,
    "even", "odd"
  )
]

# --- Titer response group (>= 100 vs < 100) for barplot ---
elisa_naivealum[, HBsAb_group := ifelse(elisa.HBsAb >= 100, ">= 100", "< 100")]

# Save for downstream use
saveRDS(elisa_sub, "./outs/elisa_sub_with_approxMonthsWeeks.rds")

```

## 2. Final Timepoint Titer Summary Plot (by Study Arm + CNBx subset)
```{r}
# Build long table: one row per participant per plotgroup
toplot <- final_timepoint_elisa[
  , .(Participant, final.timepoint.hbsab, Age, Study.arm)
][!is.na(final.timepoint.hbsab)]

toadd        <- copy(toplot)
toadd[,  plotgroup := "Aggregate"]
toplot[, plotgroup := Study.arm]

# CNBx participants (lymph node biopsy subset)
cnbx_ids <- c(
  "hbvx-0022", "hbvx-0029", "hbvx-0033", "hbvx-0036",
  "hbvx-0041", "hbvx-0043", "hbvx-0058", "hbvx-0063",
  "hbvx-0069", "hbvx-0076"
)
cnbx <- toplot[Participant %in% cnbx_ids]
cnbx[, plotgroup := "CNBx"]

toplot_all <- rbind(cnbx, toplot, toadd)
toplot_all[, plotgroup := factor(
  plotgroup,
  levels = c("Aggregate", "HBVimmune-Alum", "HBVnaive-Alum", "HBVnaive-CpG", "CNBx")
)]


# Geometric means per plotgroup
gmeans <- toplot_all[, .(
  geomean = 10^mean(log10(final.timepoint.hbsab), na.rm = TRUE)
), by = plotgroup]

# Log scale
toplot_all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = plotgroup, y = final.timepoint.hbsab)) +
  geom_crossbar(
    data    = gmeans,
    aes(y = geomean, ymin = geomean, ymax = geomean),
    width   = 0.75, fatten = 2, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    #aes(fill = Study.arm),
    shape = 21, size = 1.5, width = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 1000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  tc() + xlab("") + ylab("mIU/mL") +
  ggtitle("Final Visit HBsAb") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.3, 0.2))) 

ggsave("./figs/finalvisit_hbsab_byarm.pdf", width = 2, height = 3)

# Linear scale version
toplot_all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = plotgroup, y = final.timepoint.hbsab)) +
  geom_crossbar(
    data  = gmeans,
    aes(y = geomean, ymin = geomean, ymax = geomean),
    width = 0.6, fatten = 1.5, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    shape = 21, size = 2, #alpha = 0.85, 
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  tc() + xlab("") + ylab("mIU/mL") +
  ggtitle("Final Visit HBsAb") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

ggsave("./figs/finalvisit_hbsab_byarm_linearscale.pdf", width = 2, height = 3)


```

## 3. HBVnaive-Alum: Kinetics & Age Effects
```{r}
# =============================================================================

# --- 3a. Spaghetti -----
p1 <- elisa_naivealum %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = approxWeeks_fromDAYS, y = elisa.HBsAb)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 1000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  ylab("mIU/mL") + xlab("Weeks") +
  #ggtitle("HBVnaive-Alum") +
  tc() + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1,0.1))) 
p1

elisa_naivealum[, vx_visit := fifelse(endsWith(Visit, "0"), "yes", "no")]


p2 <- elisa_naivealum %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = approxWeeks_fromDAYS, y = elisa.HBsAb, fill = vx_visit)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant), alpha = 0.2
            ) +
  geom_point(#alpha = 0.5, 
    shape = 21) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 1000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  ylab("mIU/mL") + xlab("Weeks") +
  #ggtitle("HBVnaive-Alum") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white","red")) +
  tc() + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1,0.1))) 
p2

p2 + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("./figs/naivealum_timecourse_vxvisit.pdf", width = 4, height = 3)


# --- 3b. Geometric mean ± SEM over time (complete cases only) -----
complete_naivealum <- copy(elisa_naivealum)
complete_naivealum<- complete_naivealum[Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum"][
  Visit %in% c("v1w0","v1w1","v2w0","v2w1","v2w4","v3w0","v3w1","v3w4")
][, if (.N == 8) .SD, by = Participant]

naive_summary <- complete_naivealum[, .(
  mean_log = mean(log10(elisa.HBsAb), na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_log  = sd(log10(elisa.HBsAb),   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N)
), by = approxWeeks][, `:=`(
  mean_val = 10^mean_log,
  ymin_sem = 10^(mean_log - sem_log),
  ymax_sem = 10^(mean_log + sem_log),
  ymin_ci  = 10^(mean_log - 1.96 * sem_log),
  ymax_ci  = 10^(mean_log + 1.96 * sem_log)
)]

p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_errorbar(data = naive_summary,
                aes(x = approxWeeks, ymin = ymin_sem, ymax = ymax_sem), width = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data  = naive_summary, aes(x = approxWeeks, y = mean_val)) +
  geom_point(data = naive_summary, aes(x = approxWeeks, y = mean_val)) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 1000), breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  ylab("") + xlab("Approx. Weeks") +
  #ggtitle("HBVnaive-Alum") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  tc() + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2,0.1))) +
  theme(
  axis.title.y = element_blank()) #,
  #axis.text.y  = element_blank())

(p1 | p2) + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1.5))+
  plot_annotation(
    title = "HBVnaive-Alum HBsAb",
    #subtitle = "This subtitle applies to the whole assembly",
    #caption = "Source: Your Data Study 2026"
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(#size = 18, face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5)
    )
  ) #& theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 0, l = 5))

ggsave("./figs/naivealum_timecourse_sem.pdf", width = 6, height = 3)

# --- 3c. Age split (<=50 vs >50): GM ± SEM on log scale ----
age_model <- lmer(
  log10(elisa.HBsAb + 1) ~ approxMonths * AgeSplit50 + (1 | Participant),
  data = elisa_naivealum
)
summary(age_model)

age_p_val <- summary(age_model)$coefficients["AgeSplit50>50", "Pr(>|t|)"]
p_label   <- paste0("Global Age Effect: p = ", round(age_p_val, 3))

age_summary <- elisa_naivealum[, .(
  mean_log = mean(log10(elisa.HBsAb), na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_log  = sd(log10(elisa.HBsAb),   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N)
), by = .(approxMonths, AgeSplit50)][, `:=`(
  geom_mean = 10^mean_log,
  lower_sem = 10^(mean_log - sem_log),
  upper_sem = 10^(mean_log + sem_log)
)]

ggplot(age_summary, aes(x = approxMonths, y = geom_mean, color = AgeSplit50)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower_sem, ymax = upper_sem),
    width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.2)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E66100", "#5D3A9B")) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 1)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = max(elisa_naivealum$elisa.HBsAb, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = p_label, size = 5, fontface = "italic") +
  ylab("HBsAb GM ± SEM") + xlab("Approx. Months") +
  tsp()
#ggsave("./figs/agesplit50_95CI.pdf", width = 5, height = 3)

# --- 3d. Responder trajectory: final v3w4 titer > vs <= 100 ----
interaction_p <- summary(
  lmer(log10(elisa.HBsAb + 1) ~ approxWeeks * final_tmp_titer + (1 | Participant),
       data = complete_naivealum)
)$coefficients["approxWeeks:final_tmp_titerUnder100", "Pr(>|t|)"]

p_label_int <- paste0("p = ", format(interaction_p, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE))

responder_summary <- complete_naivealum[!is.na(final_tmp_titer), .(
  mean_log = mean(log10(elisa.HBsAb + 1), na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_log  = sd(log10(elisa.HBsAb + 1),   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N)
), by = .(approxWeeks, final_tmp_titer)][, `:=`(
  mean_val = 10^mean_log - 1,
  ymin_val = 10^(mean_log - sem_log) - 1,
  ymax_val = 10^(mean_log + sem_log) - 1
)]
p_naivealum_resp <- ggplot(
  responder_summary,
  aes(x = approxWeeks, y = mean_val, color = final_tmp_titer)
) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(1)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(1)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ymin_val, ymax = ymax_val),
    width = 1.5, position = position_dodge(1)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Over100" = "steelblue", "Under100" = "firebrick3")) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 1000), breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  labs(
    y        = "HBsAb mIU/mL",
    x        = "Approx. Weeks",
    color    = "v3w4 Response",
   # subtitle = paste0("Trajectory interaction:\n", p_label_int)
    subtitle = paste0(#"Trajectory interaction:\n", 
                      p_label_int)

  ) +
  ggtitle("HBVnaive-Alum") +
  ct1 + tc() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2,0.1))) 
p_naivealum_resp
ggsave("./figs/titersplit100_SEM_by_finalv3w4response.pdf", width = 4, height = 3)

# Age comparison between responder groups (Wilcoxon)
stat_age_naivealum <- elisa_naivealum[!is.na(final_tmp_titer)] %>%
  unique(by = c("Participant", "Age", "final_tmp_titer")) %>%
  wilcox_test(elisa.HBsAb ~ final_tmp_titer) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

naive_alum_age <- elisa_naivealum[!is.na(final_tmp_titer)] %>%
  unique(by = c("Participant", "Age", "final_tmp_titer")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = final_tmp_titer, y = Age, fill = final_tmp_titer)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +
  geom_quasirandom(shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Over100" = "steelblue", "Under100" = "firebrick3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 15,
           label = paste0("p = ", round(stat_age_naivealum$p.adj, 3)),
           #size = 4, 
           fontface = "italic") +
  tc() + labs(x = "") + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggtitle("HBVnaive-Alum") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
naive_alum_age
ggsave("./figs/age_by_finalv3w4response.pdf", width = 2, height = 2.5)

# Visit-level Wilcoxon (v1w0, v2w0, v3w0) by age group
visits_key <- c("v1w0", "v2w0", "v3w0")
elisa_select <- elisa_naivealum[Visit %in% visits_key]

stat_visit_age <- elisa_select %>%
  group_by(Visit) %>%
  wilcox_test(elisa.HBsAb ~ AgeSplit50) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Visit", dodge = 0.8) %>%
  filter(p.adj.signif != "ns") %>%
  mutate(y.position = c(2.8, 3)[seq_len(n())])

geomData_visit <- elisa_select[, .(
  geo_mean.elisa = 10^mean(log10(elisa.HBsAb[elisa.HBsAb > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(Visit, Study.arm, AgeSplit50)]

elisa_select %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = elisa.HBsAb, x = Visit, color = AgeSplit50)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(
    data = geomData_visit[Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum"],
    aes(y = geo_mean.elisa, group = AgeSplit50),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E66100", "#5D3A9B")) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_visit_age, label = "p.adj.signif",
                     tip.length = 0.01, size = 8) +
  labs(y = "HBsAb mIU/mL", x = "", color = "Age Group") +
  tsp()

#ggsave("./figs/v1w0.v2w0.v3w0_agesplit50_geo_mean.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)

```

## 6. Age-Titer Correlations and overall fold change (All Arms)
```{r}





# Helper: Kendall tau subtitle
kendall_subtitle <- function(data, x, y) {
  test <- cor.test(data[[x]], log10(data[[y]] + 1), method = "kendall")
  tau  <- round(test$estimate, 2)
  p    <- signif(test$p.value, 2)
  bquote(tau == .(tau) ~ "," ~ italic(p) == .(p))
}

# Shared plot factory
age_cor_plot <- function(data, arm_label, show_ylab = TRUE) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Age, y = final.timepoint.hbsab)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 1000)) +
    annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
    tc() +
    ylab(if (show_ylab) "Final Visit HBsAb (mIU/mL)" else "") +
    labs(
      title    = arm_label,
      subtitle = kendall_subtitle(data, "Age", "final.timepoint.hbsab")
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "gray30")
    )
}

p_cor_all    <- age_cor_plot(elisa_sub,                          "All 3 Study Arms", show_ylab = TRUE)
p_cor_immune <- age_cor_plot(elisa_sub[Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum"], "HBVimmune-Alum",  show_ylab = FALSE)
p_cor_nalum  <- age_cor_plot(elisa_sub[Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum"],  "HBVnaive-Alum",   show_ylab = FALSE)
p_cor_cpg    <- age_cor_plot(elisa_sub[Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG"],   "HBVnaive-CpG",    show_ylab = FALSE)
```

```{r}

#--- multivariate end titers and meta ----


glimpse(elisa_naivealum)
vars_to_test <- c("Age", "Sex", "BMI", "Product", "SmokingStatus", "PastHistory", "MedsAtEnrollment")

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)

# ── 1. Prep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
formod <- elisa_naivealum[!is.na(final.timepoint.hbsab)]
glimpse(formod)
table(formod$final_tmp_titer)


library(tidyverse)
library(broom)

# ── 1. Prep ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
model_df <- formod %>%
  # deduplicate if needed — hbvx-0015 appears twice (v3w3 and v3w4)
  arrange(Participant, desc(offset_VisitDate)) %>%
  distinct(Participant, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    log10_titer    = log10(final.timepoint.hbsab),
    responder      = factor(final_tmp_titer, levels = c("Under100", "Over100")),
    Sex            = factor(Sex),
    SmokingStatus  = factor(SmokingStatus, levels = c("Never", "Quit", "Active"))
  ) %>%
  select(Participant, log10_titer, responder, Age, Sex, BMI, SmokingStatus) %>%
  drop_na()

cat("N after dedup + drop_na:", nrow(model_df), "\n")
cat("Responder breakdown:\n"); print(table(model_df$responder))

# ── 2. Univariable pass ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────



predictors <- c("Age", "Sex", "BMI", "SmokingStatus")

# Linear (log10 titer)
uni_linear <- map_dfr(predictors, function(v) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("log10_titer ~", v))
  tidy(lm(f, data = model_df)) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(predictor = v)
})

# Logistic (Over/Under 100)
uni_logistic <- map_dfr(predictors, function(v) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("responder ~", v))
  tidy(glm(f, data = model_df, family = binomial()),
       exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(predictor = v)
})


# cat("\n── Univariable: log10 titer ──\n")
# print(uni_linear %>% select(predictor, term, estimate, std.error, p.value) %>%
#         mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))))

#         rename(OR = estimate) %>%
#         mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))))

# ── 3. Multivariable ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────





fit_linear <- lm(
  log10_titer ~ Age + Sex + BMI + SmokingStatus,
  data = model_df
)

fit_logistic <- glm(
  responder ~ Age + Sex + BMI + SmokingStatus,
  data   = model_df,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)












cat("\n── Multivariable: log10 titer ──\n")
tidy(fit_linear, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print()

cat("\n── Multivariable: OR (Over100) ──\n")
tidy(fit_logistic, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  rename(OR = estimate) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print()













# ── 4. Diagnostics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nLinear model R²:", round(summary(fit_linear)$r.squared, 3),
    "| Adj R²:", round(summary(fit_linear)$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")
cat("Logistic AIC:", round(AIC(fit_logistic), 1), "\n")
```

```{r}
olink <- read_csv("./data/PRL_HC_1849_Extended_Report.csv")
setDT(olink)
glimpse(olink)
olink_ln <- olink[SampleID %in% c("hbvx_0022", "hbvx_0029", "hbvx_0033", "hbvx_0036", "hbvx_0041", "hbvx_0043", "hbvx_0058", "hbvx_0063", "hbvx_0069",
                                  "hbvx_0076")]
over100 <- c("hbvx_0022","hbvx_0041", "hbvx_0043", "hbvx_0058", "hbvx_0069",
                                  "hbvx_0076")
olink_ln[, titer.categ := ifelse(SampleID %in% over100, "Over100", "Under100")]

table(olink_ln$Assay)
table(olink_ln$NPX)

stat.test <- olink_ln %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(titer.categ), !is.na(NPX)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Assay) %>%
  dplyr::filter(var(NPX, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%        # drop zero-variance assays
  wilcox_test(NPX ~ titer.categ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "titer.categ")

olink_ln %>% ggplot(aes(x = titer.categ, y = NPX)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, aes(color = titer.categ)) +
  tc() + labs(x = "Assay", y = "NPX") + ggtitle("LN Biopsy Olink") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + facet_wrap(~Assay, scales = "free_y") + theme(legend.position = "none")


olink_ln %>% ggplot(aes(x = titer.categ, y = QuantifiedValue)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, aes(color = titer.categ)) +
  tc() + labs(x = "Assay", y = "pg/mL") + ggtitle("LN Biopsy Olink") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + facet_wrap(~Assay, scales = "free_y") + theme(legend.position = "none")


non_numeric <- which(!apply(pca_mat, 2, is.numeric))
non_numeric  # shows column names + indices

#PCA
olink_filt <- olink_ln[SampleType == "SAMPLE" & SampleQC == "PASS" & AssayQC == "PASS" & !is.na(NPX) & !is.na(titer.categ)]
pca_wide <- dcast(olink_filt, SampleID ~ Assay, value.var = "NPX")

library(ggrepel)

olink_filt <- olink_ln[SampleType == "SAMPLE" & SampleQC == "PASS" & AssayQC == "PASS"]

pca_wide <- dcast(olink_filt, SampleID ~ Assay, value.var = "NPX")

pca_mat <- as.matrix(pca_wide[, !colnames(pca_wide) %in% "SampleID"])
pca_mat <- apply(pca_mat, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(pca_mat) <- pca_wide$SampleID

pca_mat_clean <- pca_mat[, colSums(is.na(pca_mat)) == 0]

pca_results <- prcomp(pca_mat_clean, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

var_exp <- pca_results$sdev^2 / sum(pca_results$sdev^2)
pc1_var <- round(var_exp[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(var_exp[2] * 100, 1)

meta <- unique(olink_filt[, .(SampleID, titer.categ)])
pca_dt <- as.data.table(pca_results$x, keep.rownames = "SampleID")
pca_dt <- merge(pca_dt, meta, by = "SampleID")

ggplot(pca_dt, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = titer.categ)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = titer.categ), type = "norm", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = SampleID),
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  tc() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)"),
    title = "PCA: LN Biopsy Olink",
    color = "Titer Group"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))



#scree
scree_dt <- data.table(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_exp)),
  variance = var_exp * 100,
  cumulative = cumsum(var_exp * 100)
)
scree_dt[, PC := factor(PC, levels = PC)]  # preserve order

ggplot(scree_dt, aes(x = PC, y = variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumulative, group = 1), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cumulative), color = "firebrick", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  tc() +
  labs(
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Variance Explained (%)",
    title = "Scree Plot: LN Biopsy Olink PCA"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )



# Extract loadings
loadings_dt <- as.data.table(pca_results$rotation[, 1:2], keep.rownames = "Assay")

# Scale arrows to fit point cloud
scale_factor <- max(abs(pca_dt[, .(PC1, PC2)])) / max(abs(loadings_dt[, .(PC1, PC2)])) * 0.7

loadings_dt[, PC1_scaled := PC1 * scale_factor]
loadings_dt[, PC2_scaled := PC2 * scale_factor]

ggplot() +
  # Sample points
  geom_point(data = pca_dt, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = titer.categ), size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(data = pca_dt, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, group = titer.categ, color = titer.categ),
               type = "t", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Loading arrows
  geom_segment(data = loadings_dt,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_scaled, yend = PC2_scaled),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Assay labels
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings_dt,
                  aes(x = PC1_scaled, y = PC2_scaled, label = Assay),
                  size = 2.5, color = "grey20", max.overlaps = 30) +

  geom_text_repel(data = pca_dt,
                  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = SampleID, color = titer.categ),
                  size = 2, show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  tc() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)"),
    title = "Biplot: LN Biopsy Olink PCA",
    color = "Titer Group"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))



loadings_dt[, magnitude := sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)]

# --- 1. Wide format ---
pca_wide <- dcast(olink_filt, SampleID ~ Assay, value.var = "NPX")

# --- 2. Numeric matrix (explicit, avoids character coercion) ---
pca_mat <- as.matrix(pca_wide[, !colnames(pca_wide) %in% "SampleID"])
pca_mat <- apply(pca_mat, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(pca_mat) <- pca_wide$SampleID

# --- 3. Drop assays with any NA ---
pca_mat_clean <- pca_mat[, colSums(is.na(pca_mat)) == 0]

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# --- Matrix: samples x assays, z-scored ---
heat_mat <- t(scale(pca_mat_clean))  # scale by assay (row = assay, col = sample)
ƒ
# --- Annotation: titer.categ per sample ---

)

  `Titer Group` = titer_vec,
  col = list(`Titer Group` = titer_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    `Titer Group` = list(title = "Titer Group")
  )
)
```
